about.bioZh: 我是青岛大学人工智能教育专业的大一新生，注重理论与实践结合，持续积累专业能力与综合素养。做事逻辑清晰、耐心细致，拥有良好的问题分析与落地执行能力。乐于接受挑战，抗压能力强，始终保持积极进取的学习心态。
about.bioEn: I am a freshman majoring in AI Education at Qingdao University. I focus on combining theoretical knowledge with practical experience to improve my comprehensive ability. I have clear logical thinking, good pressure resistance and problem-solving skills. With a positive learning attitude, I am willing to take challenges and keep improving myself.
